title: 축척 혼합 학습으로 W2 용량 이득의 축척 강건성 확보
hypothesis: mixing the original training pairs with 2x coarser pairs built from the same patches teaches a scale-dependent detail gain, so W2 keeps its large RR gain while passing RR2 (experiment 50: the W2 RR2 shortfall is a scale-dependent detail gain in the unobservable high band)

arms.C2MS: 43 C2 (original + W2) trained on original + 2x coarser pairs (main candidate)
arms.F1MS: current baseline F1 trained on original + 2x coarser pairs (effect of the data alone)
arms.F1: 49 F1 seed 42 (current baseline control, not retrained)

selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch0, earliest exact tie (same as the controls); coarse validation is logged only
loss: per-pixel MSE on the original batch + coarse_weight x per-pixel MSE on the same patches at the 2x coarser scale (DN/2047 coordinates)
coarse_pairs: coarse.py: GT and PAN blurred by the x2 sensor MTF (genMTF, QB GNyq, 41 taps) and decimated at phase 1 -> 32x32; MS = dataset x4 Wald operator of the coarse GT -> 8x8; LMS = interp23tap(MS). Training and validation splits only; test never used

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 with common/evaluation_protocol.py; fixed before training
judgement.primary: C2MS s42 vs F1 s42 (current baseline): v2.3 label
judgement.large_gain_condition: C2MS vs F1 is 개선 AND RR dPSNR >= +0.40 dB
judgement.diagnostic_1: C2MS vs C2: RR dPSNR >= -0.15 dB while the RR2 guard of C2MS vs F1 passes
judgement.diagnostic_2: F1MS vs F1: v2.3 label (does scale mixing help the baseline itself)
judgement.qualitative: FR and RR2 comparison panels (fixed scenes 1, 8, 11, 13, 19) of F1, C2, C2MS, F1MS
judgement.next: if the large-gain condition holds, propose C2MS seeds 43 and 44 (baseline-change candidate; requires approval)
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse-scale validation; TTA x8 results

limits: training sees 2x coarser pairs while RR2 is 4x coarser; FR (finer) is never seen
controls reused from 43 and 49 (same code path, cache, seed, schedule)
